name: beats: a long sentence with no place of the old kind is cut at a further one, and a sentence slow to say is tried too. The sentences are the recorded ones that took over 8 s (their time is in each name): seven are now said as two, at ", but", ", which says" ("It says ..."), ", then", a colon before a clause, and at a semicolon in a sentence of few letters that the estimate sees as slow; the ones that name a code ("RNR01"), an address or a list of numbers have no place and stay whole, as does one with an aside between commas. Eight recorded sentences of 6 to 8 s are newly said as two. A comma before "which is 13", a list after a colon, a few words after ", but" and a name after a colon are left whole
